Any object thrown into the region of space that moves under the effect of gravity alone is called a projectile. The path followed by the projectile is called its trajectory. A stone thrown into the air, a bullet fired from a rifle, or a bomb dropped from a flying aero plane are some examples of the projectile. It is hence mainly used in the military field.
